Hi team,

We completed final onsite loop with Ethan Walsh (ex-Neurolytics infra lead). Marcus and I recommend extending an offer at band "Senior / IC4" with a comp band of $160,000–$185,000 (base) + equity and a signing bonus up to $15k for relocation/transition. Candidate expectation: needs formal offer by 03/24 to avoid counter.

Attachments: neurolytics-offer-draft-v3.pdf (draft LOI), comp-band-market-comps.xlsx (market comps).

Key signals:
- Strong system design + production latency work on multi-tenant inference systems.
- Direct experience with KV cache and batching optimizations; shipped perf wins at scale.
- Seeks IC4 role; manager requests elevation from IC3 due to leadership on runtime architecture.

Asking: 
1) Approve the proposed band + signing bonus as an exception to the default comp guide for this ladder step.
2) If approved, permission to route to Legal for LOI and to offer to candidate by EOD 03/23.

Thanks — I can hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Soojin Lee

Appreciate the context. A few quick clarifying Qs:

- Is the ask a permanent band reclassification or a one-off leveling exception? I prefer one-off unless we have 2+ hires at that elevation.
- What is the expected equity target? Need to ensure comp mix stays within exec-approved ranges (total comp ~= 250–320k target for IC4 in this function).
- Approve sign-on up to $15k as a hiring tool; I want to see the 2–3 bullet business justification from Marcus for the exceptions doc.

Assuming the justification looks solid and People Ops confirms market comps, I can approve a one-off exception for elevation to IC4 with the proposed band. Finance + Legal need to OK the cash flow for sign-on; Marissa, can you loop them in on the spreadsheet?

Lauren / Marissa — short bullets below for the exceptions doc:

1) Business impact: Led cross-team runtime redesign at prior employer that improved per-token throughput by 18% and reduced inference cost by ~22%, enabling a new pricing tier. Equivalent work at Redwood would accelerate our Optimize roadmap and improve unit economics for high-volume customers.
2) Scope & leadership: Will own runtime sharding and mentor two IC3+ engineers; responsible for architectural decisions impacting Dedicated product reliability.
3) Market scarcity: Candidates with production sharding + KV cache expertise are rare; hiring at IC4 is the lever to secure senior hands-on architects quickly.

Equity ask: target 0.16% NCE (note: placeholder, open to comp calibration).

Candidate deadline: has another verbal from competitor; needs a written LOI by Wed 03/24.

Marcus

Thanks — reviewed the bullets and Marissa's market notes. I approve a one-off leveling exception to IC4 with the following guardrails:

- Base band: $160,000 — $185,000
- Signing bonus: up to $15,000 (one-time)
- Equity: target 0.14–0.18% NCE (final to be calibrated by Comp/CEO sign-off)

Marissa — please confirm payroll/finance clearance and ask Legal to draft LOI using the attached offer-draft as the base. Soojin — you have the green light to extend the offer once Legal has the doc. Please keep me posted if we need to stretch sign-on for relocation.
